idea.title: Your Instagram bio: before vs after
idea.angle: Buyers who like a listing tap your profile next. 'Real estate. DM for info' tells them nothing. After: who you help, where, and one clear action. A mock example agency, no real names.

slides.heading: BUYERS TAP YOUR **PROFILE** NEXT
slides.body: They like a listing, then check who you are. Your bio decides if they stay.

slides.heading: SAY WHAT YOU **DO**
slides.body:
Before: Real estate.
After:
✓ Family homes and city apartments
✓ For sale and to rent

slides.heading: SAY **WHERE** YOU WORK
slides.body:
Before: No area at all.
After:
✓ [Your City] and nearby areas
✓ Buyers know in a second if it fits

slides.heading: SAY **WHO** YOU HELP
slides.body:
Before: Best agent in town!
After:
✓ Helping families find their next home
✓ Video tours for out-of-town buyers

slides.heading: GIVE ONE CLEAR **ACTION**
slides.body:
Before: DM for info.
After:
✓ Tap WhatsApp to book a viewing
✓ One link. Not three.

slides.heading: THE FULL **EXAMPLE** BIO
slides.body:
Before: Example Realty. Real estate. DM for info.
After:
✓ Family homes and city apartments
✓ [Your City] and nearby
✓ Video tours for out-of-town buyers
✓ Tap WhatsApp to book a viewing

slides.heading: TURN PROFILE VISITS INTO **ENQUIRIES**
slides.body: Comment LISTING and I'll send you the playbook

caption:
A buyer likes your listing. Then they tap your profile. What do they see?

"Real estate. DM for info" tells them nothing.
A good bio says what you do, where you work and who you help.
Then it gives one clear action, like a WhatsApp link to book a viewing.
Change it once. It works for you every day.

What does your bio say right now?

Comment LISTING and I'll send you the playbook.
